## Problem and change

Describe the consumer problem, the resulting behaviour and any public API changes. Link the issue
when relevant. Include before/after screenshots for visible changes.

## Verification

- [ ] Generated source is up to date (`npm run generate`).
- [ ] Static checks pass (`npm run check`).
- [ ] Node and Chromium tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Consumer installation passes (`npm run check:registry`).
- [ ] Static export passes (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Tests, examples, API documentation and third-party credits are updated where affected.

Explain any skipped check and remaining limitation.
